LanguageData.CER_WorkflowGuide_FastestPathLine: Press "Arm my Colony" (top bar) - pick Cautious / Normal / Aggressive, press Arm. Done.
LanguageData.CER_WorkflowGuide_TabsLine1: 1. Equipment Packs - reusable kits (medicine, food, drugs, utility). Optional.
LanguageData.CER_WorkflowGuide_TabsLine3: 3. Equip Colonists - hands out weapons and gear by skill. Click a cell to pick one yourself.
LanguageData.CER_WorkflowGuide_TabsLineRoles: 2. Roles - save a colonist's combo as a reusable template for many colonists.
LanguageData.CER_WorkflowGuide_TabsLineBills: Bill Overview - keeps ammo production running. "Auto-generate" sizes bills for you.
LanguageData.CER_WorkflowGuide_KeyFeatureReadiness: Readiness light (top bar) - click it to fix what's wrong.
LanguageData.CER_WorkflowGuide_KeyFeatureGearTab: Gear tab panel - per-item carried / stored / in production / missing status.
LanguageData.CER_WorkflowGuide_KeyFeatureAmmoGizmo: "Ammo Loadouts" gizmo (select a pawn) - override just their ammo, no shared loadout touched.
LanguageData.CER_WorkflowGuide_KeyFeatureSaveAsRole: "Save as Role" - turn any colonist's current combo into a reusable template.
LanguageData.CER_WorkflowGuide_KeyFeatureModSettings: Mod Settings - every default (ammo counts, Arm-my-Colony presets, ...) is configurable.
LanguageData.CER_WorkflowGuide_GoodToKnowNewToCE: New to CE? Stay in Simple mode (top-right icon) and just use Arm my Colony.
LanguageData.CER_WorkflowGuide_GoodToKnowBabies: Babies/pacifists never get a weapon - but can still carry an Equipment Pack.
LanguageData.CER_WorkflowGuide_KeyFeatureOpen: Open this planner any time: 'Loadout Planner' in the Assign tab (bottom right), or the panel beside a colonist's Gear tab.
LanguageData.CER_WorkflowGuide_KeyFeatureFetchGear: 'Fetch gear now' (next to Arm my Colony) - everyone drops their work and collects their loadout right away. CE alone fetches one item every 30 s.
LanguageData.CER_WorkflowGuide_GoodToKnowReopen: This crash course shows once. Reopen it any time: Mod Settings -> Tools.
